import tilelang as T
from tilelang import prim_func, buffer, index, float16, float32
from tilelang import grid, serial, axis_remap, block, init, cast

@T.prim_func
def matmul_kernel(
    A: T.Buffer((T.index(2048), T.index(8192)), "float16"),
    B: T.Buffer((T.index(8192), T.index(4096)), "float16"),
    C: T.Buffer((T.index(2048), T.index(4096)), "float16")
):
    with T.grid(T.index(2048), T.index(4096)) as (i, j):
        with T.block("matmul"):
            vi, vj = T.axis.remap("SS", [i, j])
            with T.init():
                C[vi, vj] = T.float32(0.0)
            for k in T.serial(T.index(8192)):
                C[vi, vj] += T.cast(A[vi, k], "float32") * T.cast(B[k, vj], "float32")

    def __init__(self):
        super(ModelNew, self).__init__()

        # Call TileLang kernel
